papers.title_in_file: Quantum Computing from Graphs (Khesin, MIT PhD thesis, arXiv:2501.17959v1)
papers.what_it_is: A PhD thesis on the graph formalism for stabilizer states and codes: merging graph states under non-Clifford (C3) gates, a canonical form and algorithms for extended graph states, a universal graph representation of stabilizer codes with code constructions, QLO-game views of coding algorithms and random codes, and equivalence classes of CSS and Clifford codes in the ZX-calculus.
